topic: Google Maps: 3 reasons customers walk past you

hook.say: Your *shop* is open. On *Google Maps*, it looks closed.
hook.title:
Open in real life.
*Closed* on Maps.

problems.say: Problem one: no *hours*, no photos, no menu. So people *pick* the place next door.
problems.head: Search *results*

fix.say: The fix: a profile with *hours*, real *photos* and a menu link that goes to *your* website.
fix.head: Open *now*
fix.sub: Saffron Street Cafe · 8 AM to 11 PM

problems.say: Problem two: the *website* button on your profile opens a *broken* page.
problems.head: Customer *messages*

fix.say: The fix: a fast site that *loads* on any phone, with the same hours and menu as *Maps*.
fix.head: Saffron *Street*

problems.say: Problem three: *reviews* sit there unanswered, and the last one says *rude staff*.
problems.head: Latest *reviews*

fix.say: The fix: a *review* alert on WhatsApp, so you *reply* the same day, kindly.
fix.head: New *review*

recap_say: *Hours*, a *website* that works, and *replies* the same day.
cta_say: Want your *shop* to look open online? Comment *MAPS* or send us a *DM*.
caption:
Open in real life. Closed on Google Maps. 📍

1️⃣ No hours, no photos, no menu
✅ Fix: a complete profile that links to your own website

2️⃣ The website button opens a broken page
✅ Fix: a fast site with the same hours and menu

3️⃣ Reviews sit there unanswered
✅ Fix: review alerts on WhatsApp, reply the same day

topic: WhatsApp is not a CRM: 3 leaks

hook.say: *Four hundred* unread chats. Somewhere in there is your *biggest* order.
hook.title:
400 unread.
One is your *biggest order*.

problems.say: Leak one: a new *enquiry* gets buried under family groups and *good morning* messages.
problems.head: Chats · *unread*

fix.say: The fix: every enquiry lands on one *lead board*, with a name, a need and a *next step*.
fix.head: Lead *board*

problems.say: Leak two: you *promised* to follow up on Monday. It's *Thursday*.
problems.head: Ritu *Sharma*

fix.say: The fix: automatic *reminders*, so the follow-up goes out *before* the customer asks.
fix.head: Today's *follow-ups*

problems.say: Leak three: when a staff member *leaves*, their phone, and every *customer* on it, leaves too.
problems.head: Team *phones*

fix.say: The fix: one shared *inbox* the business owns, with every *conversation* saved.
fix.head: Shared *inbox*

recap_say: One *lead board*, automatic *reminders*, and an *inbox* you own.
cta_say: Losing leads in *WhatsApp*? Comment *LEADS* and we'll show you how this works.
caption:
400 unread chats. One of them is your biggest order. 💬

1️⃣ New enquiries get buried under groups and forwards
✅ Fix: a lead board with a name, a need and a next step

2️⃣ "I'll follow up Monday"… it's Thursday
✅ Fix: automatic follow-up reminders

3️⃣ A staff member leaves, and their customers go too
✅ Fix: one shared inbox the business owns

topic: Link in bio vs a real website

hook.say: Your *happiest* customers never leave a review. Your *angriest* one always does.

Happy customers: *silent*.
Angry one: *loud*.

problems.head: At the *counter*

chat.t: Sure, sure, I'll do it tonight 😊

fix.say: The fix: a *thank-you* message one hour later, with a *one-tap* review link.
fix.head: Fernlight *Salon*

problems.head: Google *reviews*

fix.say: The fix: a steady flow of *fresh* reviews, so the real picture rises to the *top*.
